just_in.title: India Plans $1.2 Billion Incentive to Build Construction Equipment and Cut China Dependence
just_in.excerpt: The seven-year scheme targets tunnel boring machines, elevators, and fire-fighting equipment — sectors where India remains heavily reliant on Chinese imports for metro rail and highway construction.
just_in.image_caption: India has announced a .2 billion production-linked incentive to boost domestic construction equipment manufacturing and reduce dependence on Chinese imports.
just_in.nri_angle: For Indian companies and NRI investors watching India's infrastructure buildout, the new scheme signals both an investment opportunity and an acknowledgment that previous manufacturing incentive approaches have fallen short.

just_in.title: Nvidia's NOOA Framework Shows the AI Harness, Not the Model, Is What Drives Performance
just_in.excerpt: An open-source Python framework from Nvidia Labs achieves top benchmark scores at half the token cost of competing systems, suggesting that how you orchestrate an AI model matters as much as the model itself.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian engineers and AI researchers in the diaspora — who form a significant share of the global AI workforce — will find NOOA relevant as an open-source tool for building more efficient AI agent systems.

just_in.title: California Prepares to Celebrate Its First Diwali as an Official State Holiday
just_in.excerpt: Assembly Bill 268 makes California the third U.S. state to recognize the festival of lights, giving nearly 900,000 Indian Americans a new marker of cultural inclusion.

just_in.title: Federal Plan Forces Deep Water Cuts on Arizona, California, and Nevada as Colorado River Reservoirs Hit Record Lows
just_in.excerpt: A new two-year Interior Department plan mandates a 27% cut to Arizona, 10% to California, and 16% to Nevada through 2028, with no mandatory reductions for upper basin states.
just_in.image_caption: Lake Mead, one of the key Colorado River reservoirs, where water levels have dropped to record lows. A new federal plan mandates deep cuts to water allocations for Arizona, California, and Nevada.
just_in.nri_angle: Major Southwest metro areas with large Indian diaspora populations — Phoenix, Tucson, Las Vegas, and Southern California — face rising water costs and potential supply disruptions from the federal cuts.

just_in.title: Harvard Urges International Students to Return Before September 15 as New Visa Rule Takes Effect
just_in.excerpt: The university's International Office advises F-1 and J-1 visa holders to be physically present in the U.S. when DHS replaces open-ended stays with a four-year cap, warning that re-entry after the deadline triggers the new framework.

food.title: America's Teahouse Boom Meets India's Chai Heritage as Tea Goes Mainstream
food.excerpt: Chinese tea chains and late-night teahouses are driving a tea revolution across US cities, creating new space for India's deep chai traditions.
food.image_caption: A cup of traditional Indian chai. America's growing teahouse culture is drawing on India's centuries-old chai heritage as specialty tea goes mainstream.
food.nri_angle: Tea is central to Indian culture — the modern teahouse trend connects to India's chai heritage and creates space for authentic Indian tea brands in the US market

food.title: American Mother in Delhi Shows How Her Family of Six Eats Out for Under $10
food.excerpt: US content creator Kristen Fischer compares daily meal costs in India and America, highlighting a tenfold price gap that resonates with diaspora families who navigate both food cultures.
food.image_caption: A spread of Indian dishes at a restaurant table. American expat Kristen Fischer shared how her family of six eats out in Delhi for under ten dollars.
food.nri_angle: The tenfold price difference between Indian and American restaurant meals is a lived reality for millions of Indian Americans who regularly travel between the two countries. Fischer's video puts numbers to what the diaspora already knows about India's food affordability.

food.title: British-Indian Doctor's Gut-Friendly Pistachio Chocolate Frozen Yoghurt Recipe
food.excerpt: Dr Rupy Aujla shares a no-churn frozen dessert that combines live-culture yoghurt, pistachios, and dark chocolate for a treat that supports gut health without an ice cream maker.
food.image_caption: A serving of pistachio chocolate frozen yoghurt. A British-Indian doctor shared a gut-friendly recipe using just three ingredients.

food.title: Mawa Peda: The Three-Ingredient Indian Sweet That Has Endured for Centuries
food.excerpt: Made from nothing more than reduced milk, sugar, and cardamom, mawa peda remains one of India's most beloved sweets — and one of the easiest to make at home.
food.image_caption: Freshly made mawa pedas arranged on a plate, garnished with slivers of pistachio and almond. The traditional Indian sweet is a staple of festivals and temple offerings across the country.
food.nri_angle: Mawa peda is a nostalgic festival sweet that diaspora families often make at home, with tips for sourcing or substituting mawa abroad.

travel.excerpt: Delhi's new master plan includes air taxis and air pods alongside inland waterways and new corridors linking the capital to Noida's Jewar Airport.
travel.image_caption: An electric air taxi concept aircraft. Delhi's Master Plan 2047 includes provisions for urban air mobility infrastructure.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs visiting Delhi may eventually benefit from air taxi services, though the inclusion is a planning framework entry rather than a concrete service launch.

travel.title: Why Spiritual Seekers Travel to Mount Kailash: Sadhguru's Journey Brings the Ancient Pilgrimage Into Focus
travel.excerpt: Mount Kailash is revered across Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism and the Bon tradition. Sadhguru's continued association with the mountain has renewed interest in what the pilgrimage means.
travel.image_caption: Mount Kailash in Tibet, a sacred pilgrimage site in Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism.
travel.nri_angle: For diaspora Hindus and spiritual seekers, Mount Kailash represents a profound connection to their spiritual heritage, and Sadhguru's journeys have made the pilgrimage more visible to a global audience.

travel.title: UK-India Personal Cargo Demand Surges as Diaspora Prepares for Diwali Season
travel.excerpt: Cargo Force reports double-digit growth projections after completing 52,000 shipments in two years, with demand rising in Tier II and III Indian cities.
travel.nri_angle: Nearly 1.9 million British Indians regularly ship gifts, household goods and personal effects to family in India, and the pre-Diwali surge is the busiest period of the year.

travel.title: In Meghalaya, Living Root Bridges Grow Stronger With Every Passing Year
travel.excerpt: Khasi and Jaintia villagers guide the roots of rubber fig trees across rivers for decades, creating self-healing bridges now nominated for UNESCO World Heritage status.
travel.image_caption: A living root bridge in Meghalaya formed from the aerial roots of rubber fig trees. These structures, maintained by the Khasi people for centuries, grow stronger with each passing year.
travel.nri_angle: The living root bridges of Meghalaya represent a unique piece of Indian heritage now gaining global recognition, offering diaspora travelers a compelling reason to explore the northeast.

travel.title: Foreign Tourists Praise Delhi Metro as Cleaner and Safer Than Western Underground Systems
travel.excerpt: A viral video by a British travel creator comparing Delhi Metro favorably to London's Underground has renewed attention on India's expanding metro infrastructure and its affordability.
travel.image_caption: A Delhi Metro train at a station platform. Foreign tourists have praised the system as cleaner and safer than comparable Western underground networks.
travel.nri_angle: Delhi Metro improvements relevant to diaspora members who travel to India regularly and notice infrastructure changes
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Inside the Traditional Karnataka Home Where Rishab Shetty's Kantara Was Filmed
travel.excerpt: Sai Radha Heritage in Muloor, Udupi, the beachside ancestral home that served as the landlord's residence in the blockbuster film, is now a heritage lodge drawing visitors from across India.
travel.image_caption: Rishab Shetty, writer-director and star of Kantara. The traditional Karnataka home featured in the film has become a tourist attraction.

travel.title: IndiGo Website Outage Blocks Flight Bookings and Check-Ins Across India
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline by market share experienced a website malfunction that prevented customers from booking tickets, with third-party platforms also reporting disruptions.

travel.excerpt: The airline is reversing its decade-old strategy and adding premium seats as it tries to close a profitability gap with Delta and United.
travel.image_caption: American Airlines is retrofitting over 800 narrowbody aircraft with seatback screens, reversing its earlier strategy of removing in-flight entertainment.
travel.nri_angle: Relevant for frequent US-India travelers who use American's domestic network for connecting flights

carousel.title: Harvard Urges International Students to Return Before September 15 as New Visa Rule Takes Effect
carousel.excerpt: The university's International Office advises F-1 and J-1 visa holders to be physically present in the U.S. when DHS replaces open-ended stays with a four-year cap, warning that re-entry after the deadline triggers the new framework.
carousel.image_caption: Harvard University's Widener Library in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The university has urged international students to return to the U.S. before September 15 when new visa regulations take effect.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian students — one of the largest international student populations in the U.S. — face extension filing requirements mid-program under the new four-year cap, with particular impact on STEM doctoral candidates.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Federal Plan Forces Deep Water Cuts on Arizona, California, and Nevada as Colorado River Reservoirs Hit Record Lows
carousel.excerpt: A new two-year Interior Department plan mandates a 27% cut to Arizona, 10% to California, and 16% to Nevada through 2028, with no mandatory reductions for upper basin states.
carousel.image_caption: Lake Mead, one of the key Colorado River reservoirs, where water levels have dropped to record lows. A new federal plan mandates deep cuts to water allocations for Arizona, California, and Nevada.
carousel.nri_angle: Major Southwest metro areas with large Indian diaspora populations — Phoenix, Tucson, Las Vegas, and Southern California — face rising water costs and potential supply disruptions from the federal cuts.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Awarapan 2 Crosses Rs 113 Crore in First Week, Becomes Emraan Hashmi's Biggest Solo Hit
carousel.excerpt: The Vishesh Films sequel earned Rs 161 crore worldwide in seven days, dominating the Independence Day box office and leaving Sunny Deol's Batwara 1947 far behind.
carousel.image_caption: A promotional still from Awarapan 2 featuring Emraan Hashmi. The film crossed Rs 113 crore nett in India in its first week, becoming his highest-grossing solo release.
carousel.nri_angle: The film's Rs 26 crore overseas gross reflects strong Bollywood engagement from the Indian diaspora, with nostalgia for the 2007 original driving NRI ticket sales.

carousel.title: Sony Bags TV Rights for India-Afghanistan T20I Series as Ganesh Chaturthi Schedule Push Adds New Twist
carousel.excerpt: The three-match Delhi series in September marks Afghanistan's first time officially hosting India in bilateral T20Is, while the schedule clash effectively ends the proposed India-Bangladesh tour.
carousel.image_caption: Afghanistan and India are set to play a T20I series, with Sony securing the TV broadcast rights amid a scheduling reshuffle due to Ganesh Chaturthi.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans abroad can watch on Sony Sports and FanCode; the Ganesh Chaturthi match would coincide with a major diaspora festival celebration.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Nvidia's NOOA Framework Shows the AI Harness, Not the Model, Is What Drives Performance
carousel.excerpt: An open-source Python framework from Nvidia Labs achieves top benchmark scores at half the token cost of competing systems, suggesting that how you orchestrate an AI model matters as much as the model itself.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian engineers and AI researchers in the diaspora — who form a significant share of the global AI workforce — will find NOOA relevant as an open-source tool for building more efficient AI agent systems.

carousel.title: India Plans $1.2 Billion Incentive to Build Construction Equipment and Cut China Dependence
carousel.excerpt: The seven-year scheme targets tunnel boring machines, elevators, and fire-fighting equipment — sectors where India remains heavily reliant on Chinese imports for metro rail and highway construction.
carousel.image_caption: India has announced a .2 billion production-linked incentive to boost domestic construction equipment manufacturing and reduce dependence on Chinese imports.
carousel.nri_angle: For Indian companies and NRI investors watching India's infrastructure buildout, the new scheme signals both an investment opportunity and an acknowledgment that previous manufacturing incentive approaches have fallen short.
